name: Church of St Michael
notes: No 6.30am and 6pm Mass on public holidays.
On public holidays on Sundays, Mass timings follow the weekend schedule; the public holiday is celebrated on the following Monday.

info.confession: Sacrament of Reconciliation is 30 minutes before the Eucharistic Celebrations on weekends.
devotions: Liturgy of the Hours on Zoom: Mon-Sat 8.00am Lauds Prayer, 12.30pm Mid-day Prayer; Sun 8.00am Lauds Prayer. Register with csm.secretariat@catholic.org.sg for Zoom details.
info.office_hours: Parish Office: Mondays to Fridays 8.30am-5.00pm; Saturdays 8.30am-11.30am, 2.00pm-4.30pm.
good_to_know: No 6.30am and 6pm Mass on public holidays.
On public holidays on Sundays, Mass timings follow the weekend schedule; the public holiday is celebrated on the following Monday.

events.title: Marriage Encounter 2026
events.text: ME Weekend is for married couples who wish to experience marriage in a new light. October Weekend (2 - 4 October) is filling up. Secure your Weekend at wwmesg.org today!

events.title: Talk on the Creed
events.text: What do Catholics believe in? What is this thing that Catholics recite every week during the Eucharistic Celebration? Join us to discover what these words actually mean for our lives. Register: https://tinyurl.com/CSMTalkonCreed

events.text: Open to older adults above 60 years old staying in St. George’s & St. Michael’s estate.
